# Test fixtures

| File | Origin | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gamma_markets_sample.json` | **Synthetic.** Written from the official Gamma API docs (`GET /markets`) | Live API returned HTTP 451 from the dev environment, so no real capture exists yet. It mixes field encodings (JSON strings and native lists, string and numeric numbers) and edge cases (closed, missing id, malformed values, non-Yes/No outcomes). **Replace or extend it with a real capture from `data/raw/polymarket/` once access works.** |
| `http_451_cloudflare.json` | **Real capture** (2026-10-04, curl, no Accept header) | Plain-text body `error code: 1026`. Contains no client IP. |
| `http_451_cloudflare_json.json` | **Real capture** (2026-10-04, `moneylab diagnose`, `Accept: application/json`) | Structured Cloudflare error JSON (`error_name=legal_block`, `error_category=legal`). Contains no client IP. |

| `clob_books_sample.json` | **Synthetic.** `GET /book` shape from the CLOB OpenAPI spec (2026-10-04) | YES and NO books. Bids are deliberately ascending (as in the WS docs example) to test sorting. |
| `clob_market_info_sample.json` | **Synthetic.** `GET /clob-markets/{condition_id}` shape | Politics-like fee `fd.r=0.04`, tick 0.01, min size 5. |
| `clob_rewards_market_sample.json` | **Synthetic.** `GET /rewards/markets/{condition_id}` shape | Max spread 3c, min size 50, 20/day. |
| `clob_timeline_mm.json` | **Synthetic**, generated | 2h, 60s snapshots: 80 min mean-reverting YES mid, then a 40-minute drift. NO book mirrors YES. No resolution. |
| `clob_timeline_mispricing.json` | **Synthetic**, generated | 1h, 60s snapshots with 4 dislocated NO books (complement gap) and an invented `fair_yes` signal. Resolves YES; the outcome is arbitrary. |

Recorder/replay tests (`tests/test_recorder.py`, `tests/test_replay.py`) add **no new fixture files**: they record
`clob_timeline_*.json` through `TimelineFixtureSource` into `tmp_path`, or build small **synthetic** `/book` payloads
inline (token ids `TOK-A-*`, `TOK-B-*`). The HTTP 451 path reuses the real capture `http_451_cloudflare_json.json`.
Recorded datasets live under `data/raw/polymarket/recordings*/` and are git-ignored; never copy one into
`tests/fixtures/` without recording its origin here.

All `clob_*` files are produced by `generate_clob_fixtures.py` (seeded, deterministic). Their prices, sizes, ids and
paths are invented. **No simulation result on them is evidence of profitability.** Replace them with recorded `/books`
responses from `data/raw/polymarket/` once the API can be reached legally, then re-run the simulations and update
the golden values in `tests/test_simulation_e2e.py`.

## Upbit

| File | Origin | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `upbit_ws_timeline_synthetic.json` | **Synthetic**, generated by `generate_upbit_fixtures.py` (seeded) | Scripted KRW-BTC WebSocket session in the documented DEFAULT message shapes (websocket-orderbook / websocket-trade, checked 2026-10-06): a 429 handshake, a session with 30-unit books, trades whose exchange timestamps interleave with the books, an identical book with a new timestamp (must be kept), a malformed frame and a 1006 close, then a reconnect that re-sends the last book and trade as SNAPSHOT (duplicates). `meta.synthetic = true`; the CLI refuses fixtures without it. Prices, sizes, `sequential_id`s and timestamps are invented. |

| `upbit_candles_synthetic.json` | **Synthetic**, hand-written series spec (2026-10-12) | Read by `providers/upbit/candle_fixture.py`, which expands it into REST candle rows in the field shapes checked live on 2026-10-12 (`/v1/candles/days`, `/v1/candles/minutes/60`). `now_utc` 2026-01-15T10:30Z, so the newest day and hour candles are still in progress; one day (01-08) and one hour (01-15T03) are omitted to produce gaps. Linear invented prices. `meta.synthetic = true`; the CLI refuses fixtures without it. |

`tests/upbit_helpers.py` and the Upbit tests build further **synthetic** messages inline. **Real Upbit captures are never
copied into `tests/fixtures/`**: they stay under `data/raw/upbit/recordings/` (git-ignored, `provenance = real`).

## v0.4 research

The research tests (`tests/test_research_*.py`, `tests/research_helpers.py`) add **no fixture files**. They build
**synthetic** `MarketEvent` sequences inline (deterministic sine-wave mids on a 1,000 KRW tick, invented sizes, trades
and reconnects) and **synthetic** scripted Upbit sessions through `ScriptedWsSource` (`provenance = fixture`). Pipeline
results on them are `NOT_EVIDENCE` or `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` and never a research result.

Fixtures must never contain secrets, private keys or personal IP addresses.
